title: Selected coordinate belongs to the free support
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign-valued Boolean variables, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction for which the restricted function is nonconstant. The first coordinate in the support of the first term compatible with $\rho$, among coordinates left free by $\rho$, belongs to that term's support intersected with the set of free coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ variables
The function restricted by $\rho$ is nonconstant
